status.en: 128 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Abuja, Lagos and Kaduna.
status.nb: 128 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Abuja, Lagos og Kaduna.

summary.en: Bandits in Plateau State have killed nine civilians in one attack and three miners at a mining site, while also kidnapping six people and stealing livestock in Sokoto. Armed groups in northern forests have been filmed wearing army uniforms and caps, and security forces rescued 125 kidnapping victims and killed 21 ISWAP fighters in Borno. Troops in Zamfara foiled a terrorist attack on Kwanan Ayo and rescued two civilians, and a suspected robber killed a person known as Benue Chris Brown in Makurdi. Police are searching for the family of a Canadian-Nigerian man killed in a road crash near Lagos Airport. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Banditter i Plateau State har drept ni sivile i ett angrep og tre gruvearbeidere på en gruveplass, samtidig som de kidnappet seks personer og stjålet husdyr i Sokoto. Væpnede grupper i nordlige skoger er blitt filmet i hæruniformer og caps, og sikkerhetsstyrker reddet 125 kidnappingsofre og drepte 21 ISWAP-krigere i Borno. Tropper i Zamfara avverget et terrorangrep på Kwanan Ayo og reddet to sivile, og en mistenkt røver drepte en person kjent som Benue Chris Brown i Makurdi. Politiet leter etter familien til en kanadisk-nigeriansk mann som ble drept i en veitrafikkulykke nær Lagos flyplass. Konflikten registrerte 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Boko Haram insurgency
background.extract: The Boko Haram insurgency began in July 2009, when the militant Islamist and jihadist rebel group Boko Haram started an armed rebellion against the government of Nigeria. Boko Haram targets both Muslims and Christians. Attacks are often directed at individuals perceived as supporting the Nigerian government or Islamic State after the split between them, including civil servants, local defense groups, Muslim leaders who oppose the group and other rebels like al-Qaeda and Islamic State. Most attacks are not based on the religion of the victims.
